mechanism: Duloxetine inhibits CYP2D6, which metabolizes fluphenazine, leading to increased fluphenazine levels and risk of antipsychotic adverse effects including QT prolongation; additive CNS depression and serotonergic effects also present.
action: Monitor for increased antipsychotic side effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, orthostasis, sedation); consider fluphenazine dose reduction; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended due to QT risk.
